name: Sofia Oliveira
bio:
Sofia's journey into motorsport began unconventionally, through a passion for optimizing data analysis systems in her university days. While studying computer science, she developed algorithms to predict F1 tire degradation, catching the attention of a small racing team. After graduating, she gained experience configuring complex simulations at a data analytics company before joining Rexal FMI Racing. 

As the IT Systems Manager, Sofia approaches every challenge with a structured, logical mindset. She believes in proactive problem-solving and constantly seeks ways to improve the efficiency of data flow within the team. Her focus is on developing solutions that directly impact track performance and team communications. What sets her apart is her ability to translate technical jargon into actionable insights for the engineering and strategy departments.

Sofia is also known for her work ethic, often being the first person in the office, and the last one to leave. She does not accept anything less than perfection when setting up the systems that the team relies on.

physical.hairStyle: Long, wavy hair often tied back in a practical ponytail.
physical.description: Sofia is of average height, with a focused gaze and a practical demeanor.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with code snippets and system diagrams.
Prefers to communicate technical issues with flowcharts.
Has a habit of tapping her pen rhythmically when deep in thought.
